Anya: Quick RFC follow-up — re: ownership of request auth/identity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Main question: who should be the source of truth for impersonation / act-as tokens?
Samir: My proposal: control plane issues short-lived session tokens for hosted/dedicated. For private, local agent mints tokens using customer KMS, but we keep the same token format so runtime parsing doesn't change. :thumbsup:
Maria: Caveat: if local agent mints tokens, we must ensure no telemetry that can leak PII back to control plane. Need explicit opt-in for reporting.
Ken: Also need clear fallback rules: if agent can't reach KMS, do NOT auto-fallback to control plane (security policy). Instead return 503 + guidance to operators.
Anya: Agreed. Suggest mapping to a responsibility matrix: 1) Hosted = control-plane identity management. 2) Dedicated = control-plane-owned tokens but hosted in customer VPC when requested. 3) Private = local agent/KMS. We should document allowed cross-checks and what data can cross the control plane boundary.
Samir: For runtime surface, keep header invariant: use `X-RI-Session` for all modes. Runtime validates header using a configured verifier chain so it stays agnostic to where the token was minted. Example: `X-RI-Session: s=eyJhbGci...`
Maria: Implementation detail: verifier plugin chain should be pluggable. Example plugins: `rp-token-verifier`, `local-jwk-checker`, `kms-signed-verifier`. Plugins can be enabled per-deployment in config.
Ken: Ops concern: rolling out new verifier plugins must be backward compatible. Add a feature-flag gate and a deprecation window (suggest 6 weeks). Also add a runtime fallback that emits metrics when a plugin rejects tokens.
Anya: Security question: who owns the threat-model + audits? My read: Security leads the threat model, eng-platform owns runtime implementation, devex owns SDK helpers/docs. We'll call that out in the matrix.
Samir: Quick config example for private agent (proposal):
```
agent.auth: 
  verifier_chain: ["local-jwk-checker","kms-signed-verifier"]
  telemetry_opt_in: false
```
Maria: Test matrix suggestions: token format compatibility tests, cross-env exchange tests, replay/nonce tests, and telemetry opt-in/out verification.
Ken: Add explicit emergency disable in rollout playbook: `disable_verifier_chain` flag that flips to legacy validator.
Infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for verifier plugin chain v3 -> 3 hosts (2026-03-18T12:04Z)
Anya: Samir — can you draft the responsibility matrix + PR against the RFC? Target next Wed. I'll add security's requirements to the doc.
Samir: Yep, I'll draft and include config examples + rollout notes.
Maria: +1. Also add data-leak checklist for private -> control plane interactions.
Ken: I'll add an emergency runbook note about disabling telemetry and forcing token rejection mode.
Anya: Thanks team — tracking in RFC follow-up PR and INF ticket. /cc @ops-bot
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-9876 - implement token responsibility matrix and verifier plugin chain
